name: xantham
description: Repository-level tooling dependencies, and the single pin of the `typescript` 7.x compiler. tools/proto-gen reads the shipped schema out of this package, and its platform `@typescript/typescript-<rid>` package is the `tsc --api` server the live tests drive - `Tsc.locate` walks parent directories, so the test project resolves this install. `dotnet fsi build.fsx -- <generate|test>` installs it.
